snippet.title: The Shadow Beneath - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389620/The_Shadow_Beneath/

More Gameplay Shots here : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qg0pHLcbO7w&list=PLOah4VuTTgmNFQnMU5DXqFkObrMU6Po8s

--------------------------------------------------------

The Shadow Beneath is an action roguelike where you must fulfill an ancient prophecy and rise against the demonic forces that have taken over the world.

You will battle relentless waves of enemies, master powerful abilities and reclaim what humanity lost since the Demon Lords reign began - freedom
